settings.heading: Six Guides, Free to Read
settings.intro: Each guide is a set of short chapters you can read in order or dip into. Nothing is gated and none of it asks for an email address.

settings.heading: One Answer Rather Than a Whole Guide
settings.body:
If you want a single question answered rather than a full guide, start with Diamond Education or Gemstone Education, which break the same material into individual pages.

Prefer a PDF to print or read offline? All six guides are on the downloadable guides page.

settings.heading: Would You Rather Just Ask?
settings.lead: The guides exist so nobody has to take our word for anything. If you would rather talk it through, we answer the phone ourselves.
